# Verify target EDM artists with follower_count >= 23
# Recompute quickly to avoid relying on prior variables in case of resets.
username='joseph.webe@gmail.com'
password='i5ZKWxI'
login_res = apis.spotify.login(username=username, password=password)
access_token = login_res['access_token']

edm_artists=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.search_artists(query='', genre='EDM', min_follower_count=23, page_index=i, page_limit=20, sort_by='-follower_count')
    if not page:
        break
    edm_artists.extend(page)
    i+=1

# Fetch current following (paginated)
following=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    following.extend(page)
    i+=1

target_ids=[a['artist_id'] for a in edm_artists]
following_ids=set(a['artist_id'] for a in following)
already=[aid for aid in target_ids if aid in following_ids]
delta=[aid for aid in target_ids if aid not in following_ids]

print('Target EDM artists (>=23 followers):', edm_artists)
print('Following artists:', following)
print('Already in target state:', already, 'N=', len(already))

# Irreversible action: follow artists in delta
username='joseph.webe@gmail.com'
password='i5ZKWxI'
login_res=apis.spotify.login(username=username, password=password)
access_token=login_res['access_token']

# Recompute delta (to avoid stale state)
edm_artists=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.search_artists(query='', genre='EDM', min_follower_count=23, page_index=i, page_limit=20, sort_by='-follower_count')
    if not page:
        break
    edm_artists.extend(page)
    i+=1

following=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    following.extend(page)
    i+=1

following_ids=set(a['artist_id'] for a in following)
delta=[a for a in edm_artists if a['artist_id'] not in following_ids]

print('Following now (target delta):', [(a['artist_id'], a['name']) for a in delta])

results=[]
for a in delta:
    try:
        r=apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=a['artist_id'], access_token=access_token)
        results.append((a['artist_id'], 'ok', r))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((a['artist_id'], 'fail', str(e)))

print('Follow results:', results)
